paper_title: Sound of Dark Matter: Searching for Light Scalars with Resonant-Mass Detectors
coupling_convention: dimensionless d_e (values actually constrain the combination |d_e + d_me|)
notes: Theory/proposal paper (Arvanitaki, Dimopoulos, Van Tilburg 2016) proposing resonant-mass detectors to search for scalar/modulus DM coupling to the electron mass (d_me) and electromagnetic field (d_e). The detector is sensitive to the SUM h = -(d_me + d_e)*sqrt(4piGN)phi, so it constrains both ScalarPhoton (d_e) and ScalarElectron (d_me) — coupling type is genuinely ambiguous. Main results (Cu-Si sphere blue curve, AURIGA recast red curve, DUAL, quartz) are SNR=1 projections over ~1 kHz–1 GHz (mφ ~ 4e-12 to 4e-6 eV) presented only as log-log curves in Fig.1, not readable as precise numbers. The one concretely quoted new limit is a recast of Earth's breathing-mode seismology: |d_e + d_me| ≲ 2.5e-4 (95% CL) in a narrow band around fφ≈8.1e-4 Hz (mφ≈3.35e-18 eV), reported here as the single data point.
